# LYCORE

> LYCORE builds lead generation, call handling, booking and follow-up systems for service businesses. LYCORE also optimizes your Google Business Profile, automates intake and follow-up paperwork, and is building full operating systems for service industries.

LYCORE (LYCORE GROUP LLC) is based in Albuquerque, NM and works with service businesses across the United States. Contact: services@lycore.org. LYCORE configures AI call handling to capture enquiries and route information to your staff. The AI identifies itself and follows approved business rules. It does not replace licensed professionals or make professional decisions on your behalf. Rankings, revenue, call volume and client outcomes are never guaranteed.

## Services

- [B2B outbound lead generation](https://www.lycore.org/services/outbound-lead-generation): B2B prospect research, cold email outreach, reply qualification and appointment-setting workflows for service businesses.
- [Cold email infrastructure setup](https://www.lycore.org/services/cold-email-infrastructure): Sending domains, business inboxes, SPF, DKIM and DMARC setup, plus about two weeks of initial email warm-up before launch checks.
- [AI Answering Service & Receptionist](https://www.lycore.org/services/ai-receptionist): A 24/7 AI receptionist that answers every call, screens out wrong numbers and sales calls, qualifies real customers and books them by your rules.
- [Missed Call Text Back Service](https://www.lycore.org/services/missed-call-text-back): A missed call text back service that texts the caller right after an unanswered call, so the job does not go to the next business on the list.
- [Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://www.lycore.org/services/lead-follow-up): Lead follow-up automation that replies to every enquiry, chases estimates and reminds customers, then hands over to a person when it matters.
- [Reputation Management](https://www.lycore.org/services/reputation-management): Practical review and reputation workflows for service businesses.
- [Review Automation](https://www.lycore.org/services/review-automation): Post-service review-request workflows built around the customer journey.
- [Google Business Profile Management Services](https://www.lycore.org/services/google-business-profile-management): Google Business Profile management: the right phone number, hours, categories and service area, so customers who find you on Google reach you.
- [CRM Automation](https://www.lycore.org/services/crm-automation): Customer lifecycle workflows around the CRM and operational tools your team already uses.
- [Customer Reactivation](https://www.lycore.org/services/customer-reactivation): Reactivation workflows for past customers, dormant leads, and recurring-service reminders.
- [Web Design for Service Businesses](https://www.lycore.org/services/web-design): A fast, phone-first website for service businesses that makes it obvious what you do, why to trust you, and how to call or book in one tap.
- [After-hours answering service](https://www.lycore.org/services/after-hours-answering-service): An after hours answering service that picks up nights, weekends and lunch breaks, sorts urgent from routine calls and sends you a clear summary. Free review.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Q: What kind of businesses does LYCORE work with?
  A: LYCORE works with spas, med spas, dental and veterinary clinics, real estate agents, law firms, roofers, plumbers, water restoration companies, and other service businesses. Each industry page explains a workflow for that team.
- Q: How does LYCORE answer my calls?
  A: LYCORE can configure an AI receptionist for overflow or after-hours calls. It identifies your business and itself as an AI assistant, asks approved intake questions and routes a summary through the agreed tools. Routing, coverage and fallback behavior are tested before launch.
- Q: Is the receptionist a real person or a computer?
  A: It is an AI assistant, not a person. It uses approved information about your services, hours and service area. When it cannot answer reliably or a caller needs a person, it follows your transfer or callback rules.
- Q: Will callers know they are not talking to my staff?
  A: Yes. The greeting identifies the assistant as AI acting for your business. Callers can request a person, with a transfer or callback path based on staff availability. Recording and consent requirements are reviewed during setup.
- Q: What happens after the call is answered?
  A: The configured owner receives the captured contact details and request through an approved channel. Missing information, failed notifications and unanswered handoffs need an exception path. Sensitive details are excluded from routine notifications where appropriate.
- Q: Can LYCORE transfer live calls to my team?
  A: Live transfer can be included where the phone setup supports it. You approve the transfer rules, available contacts and what happens if nobody answers. A transfer attempt is not treated as a completed handoff.
- Q: How are the websites different from what I can build myself?
  A: LYCORE websites are built specifically for service businesses that depend on phone calls. The phone number is tappable from the first screen, pages are optimized for fast mobile use, and every element is arranged to get an urgent searcher to call instead of browse. We also connect Google Business Profile, call tracking, and lead routing so you can see which pages are generating calls.
- Q: What does Google Business Profile optimization include?
  A: The scope can include checking categories, service areas, hours, photos, contact links and descriptions, then agreeing an update process. Accurate information helps visitors evaluate your business, but profile work does not guarantee placement in local results.
- Q: What is the intake and follow-up automation?
  A: A call or form can trigger intake, acknowledgement, assignment and timed follow-up. Replies, opt-outs and status changes alter or stop the sequence. Reporting sources, measures and frequency are agreed in the scope; an acknowledgement is counted separately from a human response or confirmed booking.
- Q: What does LYCORE cost?
  A: Pricing depends on what your business needs. Start with a free review — we will look at how your calls, website, and follow-up are working today and tell you plainly what would help and what it costs. No pressure, no obligation.
- Q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
  A: No. LYCORE does not require long-term contracts. We believe the work should speak for itself month over month.
